Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for agreeing to a focused workshop with the Novus Health exec + product teams. To get the calendar blocks and travel organized, could you confirm the following by end of week?

- Preferred week for onsite: Apr 19–23 or May 3–7 (we can split days between onsite + virtual).
- Exec time block: do your senior leaders want a single 90-minute deep-dive or two 45-minute slots?
- Any travel policies we should follow for bookings (preferred vendor, per-diem limits, single-seat class rules)?

We’ll hold tentative calendar slots for the weeks above and will only finalize after we get your attendee list and travel policy. I’m attaching a simple CSV template for attendees (Novus_attendees_v1.csv).

Also linking a lightweight draft agenda we can iterate on: https://drive.google.com/open?id=agenda123

If hybrid is preferred, please call out which participants will be remote — we’ll ensure room AV + streaming test in advance.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Ben Carter

Hi Ben —

Thanks — we prefer the week of Apr 19–23. For execs, a single 90-minute deep-dive works best (keeps calendars simpler).

Travel policy highlights (from procurement):
- Flights: economy (upgrades require manager approval)
- Hotel: up to $300/night; prefer Hyatt or Marriott in downtown Boston
- Ground: mileage or rideshare; we can provide parking validation for guests

I attached the attendee list with designations and remote/onsite flags (Novus_attendees_v1.csv). Can you share a proposed day-by-day agenda and a practical travel checklist?

Sam —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attendee list. Draft agenda attached (proposed_agenda_v2.pdf) — high level day flow below; we can iterate but this gives us a structure to build travel bookings and AV run-of-show: 

Day 0 (Mon Apr 19, arrival): arrival window / optional evening brief for core leads (6–8pm)
Day 1 (Tue Apr 20): Exec deep-dive (90m AM), discovery sessions PM (breakouts)
Day 2 (Wed Apr 21): Product integrations / technical Q&A (onsite labs + remote streaming)
Day 3 (Thu Apr 22): Ops & reliability review, rollout planning, open action workshop
Day 4 (Fri Apr 23): Wrap, leadership decisions, next steps 11am finish

Proposed exec block: Tue Apr 20, 09:00–10:30 ET — please confirm leaders and any hard constraints.

For travel: I’ll circulate a short travel checklist for attendees (policy-friendly) and a recommended booking window (we recommend locking flights by Apr 1 to secure rates). Draft travel checklist attached (onsite_travel_checklist.docx).

Link to agenda: https://drive.google.com/open?id=agenda123

If that looks ok I’ll go ahead and set tentative calendar holds for Apr 19–23 (all-day blocks with details) and create individual invites for execs for Tue 09:00–10:30 ET.

Ben

Ben — quick practical Qs from facilities/security: 
1) Is parking validated at the hotel or will you provide guest passes?
2) For non-US internal guests, do you have an on-site escort or badge pickup procedure?
3) Are you able to provide a one-page equipment list for customs if any demo hardware crosses borders?

Also — is there a comfortable window to book flights? Procurement asked about recommended booking cutoff to avoid premium fares.

Thanks,
Ethan
Facilities Ops | Novus Health

On Thu, Apr 1, 2027 at 14:42, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com wrote:
> Hi Ethan —
>
> Good questions. Parking: we can validate hotel parking for up to 10 guests (we will provide validated passes at arrival).
>
> Badge pickup: we will coordinate with your front desk; typically guests are pre-registered and pick up badges with a photo ID. For non-US visitors we will provide an escort for the first 90 minutes and keep a list of passport numbers offline if required by security (we will only collect if needed).
>
> Equipment for demos: we will provide a one-page manifest for customs with serial numbers and a value estimate — can you confirm if you need any particular export paperwork?
>
> Booking window: recommend locking flights by Friday Apr 1 to keep rates reasonable; after that we’ve already seen airfare creep for the week of Apr 19.
>
> I’ll follow up with a short consolidated travel checklist and standard wording for badge pickup to share with your security team.
>
> Ben
